O.outcome_detail: Pre-test normalized dominant misconceptions by FCI question

cells.quote: For example, all groups and countries follow the same trend for questions: Q4, Q28, Q19, and Q9. On the other hand, Q2 and Q14 have some difference between UJ students and the other groups / countries.
cells.note: The study reports similar trends for some questions and differences for others, but does not report a statistical test or effect size.
